overview_description.description: Elevision is an innovative Digital Media Network broadcasting news, information & advertisements inside the lifts of the UAE’s premier commercial and residential towers. They solve two problems; the need for advertisers to locate and reach consumers; and the need for property owners to effectively communicate with tenants. They deliver media to an affluent audience in a captive environment throughout their day.
